parameters.query:
SELECT id, source, company, title, location, remote, employment_type,
       url, description, salary, posted_at, skills
FROM jobs
WHERE ai_analyzed = false
  AND filter_passed = true
  AND status != 'REJECTED'
ORDER BY discovered_at DESC
LIMIT 20;
SELECT requests_made, requests_limit FROM ai_usage WHERE date = CURRENT_DATE;

parameters.jsCode:
// Build AI analysis prompt for this job
const job = $json;

const candidateProfile = `
CANDIDATE PROFILE:
Name: Ghaith Oueslati
Education: B.Eng. Computer Engineering (TWIN - Web & Internet Technologies), ESPRIT, graduating 2026
Experience: ~1 year via internships in DevSecOps, Backend, Cloud, Mobile

Technical Skills:
- Languages: JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Java, C#, C++, PL/SQL, SQL
- Frameworks: React, Angular, Node.js, NestJS, Spring Boot, .NET, Flutter, Django, Laravel, Symfony
- Databases: MySQL, MongoDB, PostgreSQL
- DevOps & Cloud: Docker, Terraform, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD
  AWS (EC2, Lambda, Secrets Manager), Azure (Container Apps, Front Door, ACR), GCP (Cloud Run, GAR)
- Security: OWASP ZAP, Trivy, SonarQube, DevSecOps, SAST, DAST, SCA
- Tools: Jenkins, Git, Swagger, Postman, Grafana, Vertex AI, Google Gemini API
- Concepts: REST APIs, Microservices, CI/CD, IaC, JWT, Keycloak, Agile/Scrum

Key Achievements:
- Cut security triage time 60% by integrating Gemini API into CI/CD (OWASP ZAP + Trivy)
- Reduced backend API latency 83% via MongoDB optimization + caching
- Built AI test-generation agent (5,200+ lines, Vertex AI, 75%+ test coverage)
- Migrated 38+ CI/CD workflows GitHub Actions → GitLab CI/CD
- Migrated 8/12 microservices GCP Cloud Run → Azure Container Apps
- 88% first-submission PR approval rate in 6-engineer team

Spoken Languages: Arabic (native), French (professional), English (professional), Italian (B2)
Visa: Tunisian national, needs sponsorship for most countries
`;

const descriptionTruncated = (job.description || '').substring(0, 5000);

const prompt = `You are a senior technical recruiter. Analyze the fit between this candidate and job.

${candidateProfile}

JOB:
Title: ${job.title}
Company: ${job.company}
Location: ${job.location || 'Not specified'}
Remote: ${job.remote ? 'Yes' : 'No'}
Type: ${job.employment_type || 'Not specified'}
Salary: ${job.salary || 'Not specified'}
Description:
${descriptionTruncated}

INSTRUCTIONS:
- Score honestly. Do NOT inflate scores because keywords overlap.
- Consider that the candidate is a recent graduate (~1 year experience via internships).
- If the job requires 3+ years of experience, reduce experience_score significantly.
- Visa: if the job explicitly offers sponsorship or is truly remote/worldwide, visa_score = 90-100. If it requires EU/US citizenship without sponsorship, visa_score = 20-40.
- Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown, no explanation.

Return exactly this JSON structure:
{
  "match_score": 0,
  "technical_score": 0,
  "experience_score": 0,
  "seniority_score": 0,
  "language_score": 0,
  "location_score": 0,
  "visa_score": 0,
  "strengths": [],
  "missing_skills": [],
  "risks": [],
  "reasoning": "",
  "should_apply": true
}`;

return [{ json: { ...job, ai_prompt: prompt } }];

parameters.query:
UPDATE jobs SET
  match_score       = {{ $json.match_score }},
  technical_score   = {{ $json.technical_score }},
  experience_score  = {{ $json.experience_score }},
  seniority_score   = {{ $json.seniority_score || 0 }},
  language_score    = {{ $json.language_score || 0 }},
  location_score    = {{ $json.location_score || 0 }},
  visa_score        = {{ $json.visa_score || 0 }},
  strengths         = '{{ JSON.stringify($json.strengths || []) }}'::jsonb,
  missing_skills    = '{{ JSON.stringify($json.missing_skills || []) }}'::jsonb,
  risks             = '{{ JSON.stringify($json.risks || []) }}'::jsonb,
  ai_reasoning      = '{{ ($json.reasoning || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  ai_analyzed       = true,
  ai_analyzed_at    = NOW(),
  status            = CASE
    WHEN {{ $json.match_score }} >= {{ $env.MIN_MATCH_SCORE || 70 }} THEN 'MATCHED'
    WHEN {{ $json.match_score }} < 40 THEN 'REJECTED'
    ELSE 'ANALYZED'
  END,
  updated_at        = NOW()
WHERE id = '{{ $json.job_id }}'::uuid
RETURNING id, company, title, match_score, status;

INSERT INTO ai_usage (date, requests_made, requests_limit)
VALUES (CURRENT_DATE, 1, {{ $env.MAX_AI_REQUESTS_PER_DAY || 50 }})
ON CONFLICT (date) DO UPDATE
SET requests_made = ai_usage.requests_made + 1,
    last_updated = NOW();
